mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM EQUITY_STRUCTURE
ORDER BY UPDATE_TIME DESC
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{pageNumber}
OFFSET #{pageNumber} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM EQUITY_STRUCTURE WHERE INVESTEE_ENTERPRISE_ID = #{investeeEnterpriseId} AND IS_CONTROLLING = 1 ORDER BY SHAREHOLDING_RATIO DESC
SELECT * FROM EQUITY_STRUCTURE WHERE INVESTEE_ENTERPRISE_ID = #{investeeEnterpriseId} AND IS_ACTUAL_CONTROLLER = 1 ORDER BY TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO DESC
SELECT * FROM EQUITY_STRUCTURE WHERE EQUITY_PATH LIKE CONCAT('%', #{startEnterpriseId}, '%', #{endEnterpriseId}, '%') ORDER BY INVESTMENT_LEVEL
SELECT * FROM EQUITY_STRUCTURE WHERE INVESTEE_ENTERPRISE_ID = #{investeeEnterpriseId} AND IS_PLEDGED = 1 ORDER BY PLEDGE_RATIO DESC

SELECT INVESTOR_TYPE as investorType, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(SHAREHOLDING_RATIO) as totalRatio, AVG(SHAREHOLDING_RATIO) as avgRatio FROM EQUITY_STRUCTURE WHERE INVESTEE_ENTERPRISE_ID = #{investeeEnterpriseId} GROUP BY INVESTOR_TYPE ORDER BY totalRatio DESC

SELECT EQUITY_NATURE as equityNature, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(SHAREHOLDING_RATIO) as totalRatio, AVG(SHAREHOLDING_RATIO) as avgRatio FROM EQUITY_STRUCTURE WHERE INVESTEE_ENTERPRISE_ID = #{investeeEnterpriseId} GROUP BY EQUITY_NATURE ORDER BY totalRatio DESC

SELECT INVESTMENT_LEVEL as investmentLevel, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(SHAREHOLDING_RATIO) as totalRatio, AVG(SHAREHOLDING_RATIO) as avgRatio FROM EQUITY_STRUCTURE WHERE INVESTEE_ENTERPRISE_ID = #{investeeEnterpriseId} GROUP BY INVESTMENT_LEVEL ORDER BY investmentLevel

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalInvestors, SUM(CASE WHEN SHAREHOLDING_RATIO >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as controllingInvestors, SUM(CASE WHEN SHAREHOLDING_RATIO >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as majorInvestors, MAX(SHAREHOLDING_RATIO) as maxRatio, SUM(SHAREHOLDING_RATIO) as totalRatio, (SELECT SUM(SHAREHOLDING_RATIO) FROM EQUITY_STRUCTURE WHERE INVESTEE_ENTERPRISE_ID = #{investeeEnterpriseId} ORDER BY SHAREHOLDING_RATIO DESC LIMIT 5 AND ROWNUM <= 5 ) as top5Ratio FROM EQUITY_STRUCTURE WHERE INVESTEE_ENTERPRISE_ID = #{investeeEnterpriseId}
SELECT * FROM EQUITY_STRUCTURE WHERE RISK_LEVEL = #{riskLevel} AND NEED_REGULATORY_ATTENTION = 1 ORDER BY UPDATE_TIME DESC
mapper.update:
UPDATE EQUITY_STRUCTURE SET EQUITY_STATUS = #{equityStatus}, UPDATE_TIME = NOW() SYSDATE WHERE EQUITY_ID IN
#{equityId}

update.foreach: UPDATE EQUITY_STRUCTURE SET INDIRECT_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO = #{item.indirectShareholdingRatio}, TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO = #{item.totalShareholdingRatio}, UPDATE_TIME = NOW() SYSDATE WHERE EQUITY_ID = #{item.equityId}

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as totalEquities, COUNT(DISTINCT INVESTEE_ENTERPRISE_ID) as totalInvestees, COUNT(DISTINCT INVESTOR_ENTERPRISE_ID) as totalInvestors, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_CONTROLLING = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as controllingEquities, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_ACTUAL_CONTROLLER = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as actualControllerEquities, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_PLEDGED = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pledgedEquities, SUM(CASE WHEN NEED_REGULATORY_ATTENTION = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as attentionEquities, SUM(INVESTMENT_AMOUNT) as totalInvestmentAmount, AVG(SHAREHOLDING_RATIO) as avgShareholdingRatio FROM EQUITY_STRUCTURE
SELECT INVESTOR_TYPE as type, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EQUITY_STRUCTURE), 2) as percentage FROM EQUITY_STRUCTURE GROUP BY INVESTOR_TYPE ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT EQUITY_NATURE as nature, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EQUITY_STRUCTURE), 2) as percentage FROM EQUITY_STRUCTURE GROUP BY EQUITY_NATURE ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT INVESTMENT_LEVEL as level, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EQUITY_STRUCTURE), 2) as percentage FROM EQUITY_STRUCTURE GROUP BY INVESTMENT_LEVEL ORDER BY level

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN IS_CONTROLLING = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as controllingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_CONTROLLING = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as nonControllingCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN IS_CONTROLLING = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as controllingPercentage FROM EQUITY_STRUCTURE

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN IS_PLEDGED = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pledgedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_PLEDGED = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as unpledgedCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN IS_PLEDGED = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as pledgedPercentage, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_PLEDGED = 1 THEN PLEDGE_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END) as totalPledgeAmount FROM EQUITY_STRUCTURE

SELECT EQUITY_ID as equityId, INVESTEE_ENTERPRISE_NAME as investeeEnterpriseName, INVESTOR_ENTERPRISE_NAME as investorEnterpriseName, INVESTOR_TYPE as investorType, SHAREHOLDING_RATIO as shareholdingRatio, TOTAL_SHAREHOLDING_RATIO as totalShareholdingRatio, INVESTMENT_AMOUNT as investmentAmount, INVESTMENT_DATE as investmentDate, EQUITY_NATURE as equityNature, EQUITY_STATUS as equityStatus, IS_CONTROLLING as isControlling, IS_PLEDGED as isPledged, RISK_LEVEL as riskLevel FROM EQUITY_STRUCTURE
ORDER BY UPDATE_TIME DESC
